topic: The doll that blinks on its own — and no one in the house is moving it
hook: The doll blinks. Nobody is touching it.
script: The doll blinks. Nobody is touching it. Annabelle the doll sits locked in a glass case at the Warren Occult Museum. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren sealed her away after a series of violent incidents around the doll. Visitors have reported the doll moving position inside the locked case. Cameras have captured unexplained shadows. The case stays locked. Follow for real paranormal cases that haunt you for days.
